note: Show & Fix tools. Keel compiles these like any manifest; the annotations follow MCP ToolAnnotations (readOnlyHint).

tools.name: read_error_display
tools.description: Read the error or information code shown on the appliance's display, from the user's live camera. Returns the code only if it can be read with enough confidence, together with what Samsung's support page says about it; otherwise says it is unclear.

tools.name: lookup_error_code
tools.description: Look up what a washing machine information code means and the steps Samsung's support page recommends.

code.description: The code as shown, e.g. '4C' or 'dE'

tools.name: book_technician
tools.description: Book a Samsung service technician visit for the appliance.

code.description: The information code the appliance shows

day.description: Day of the visit, e.g. 'Saturday' or '2026-10-03'

tools.name: list_technician_bookings
tools.description: List the technician visits booked in this conversation.
